rows.grounds: instrumental of the compound prokta-krama, indicating worship by the method already stated
feminine nominative plural participle agreeing with śaktīḥ
feminine accusative plural object of pūjayet
third singular active optative of root pūj expressing ritual obligation

items.question: By what prescribed method should the previously described powers be worshipped?
items.inference: The practitioner should worship the described powers by the prescribed method.
uncertainties: The exact set of powers referred to by proktāḥ is not specified in this excerpt.
items.plain_english: By the prescribed method, one should worship the powers that have been described; thus.
